sources.entry: Loadout - See and manage what coding assistants load — Claude Code skills, subagents, slash commands, plugins, and MCP servers, with real usage counts. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/migsilva89/loadout) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon] ![Native App][Native Icon]

summary.name: Loadout
summary.one_liner: A free, open-source native Mac app for viewing, editing and disabling the skills, subagents, slash commands, plugins and MCP servers that Claude Code, Codex and Antigravity load, with recorded skill usage counts.
use_cases: Find Claude Code skills and plugins you no longer use
Turn off an MCP server without deleting its definition
Edit or create Claude Code skills with frontmatter validation
Audit which skills a project folder exposes to the assistant
Share one skill across Claude Code, Codex and other assistants via symlinks
Remove a Claude Code plugin and back up its files
summary.what_it_does: Loadout lists every skill, subagent, slash command, plugin and MCP server found in assistant folders such as ~/.claude, ~/.codex and ~/.gemini, scoped to personal, project or plugin origin. It can disable a skill by moving its folder to ~/.claude/skills-off, and disable MCP servers while keeping their definitions. It reads existing session transcripts to count skill activations, last use and projects, and marks history formats it cannot verify as unsupported rather than showing zero. It includes a file editor with live frontmatter validation and an Ask feature that proposes changes to a copy, which the user accepts or rejects one at a time. Writes are backed up first, and deletes go to the Trash.
notable: Reads session logs for real skill usage counts, read-only
Disables skills and MCP servers without deleting them
Backs up before every write; deletes go to Trash
No account or telemetry; MIT licensed, signed and notarised
caveats: Usage counts depend on supported session log formats; missing history does not prove a skill is unused
Ask feature sends conversation and skill content to the assistant CLI's configured provider
